```yaml
name: i18n-check

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  i18n-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      BASE_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"

      - name: Fetch base branch
        run: |
          git fetch origin "$BASE_BRANCH"

      - name: Compute merge base and base‑only files
        id: base_only
        run: |
          MERGE_BASE=$(git merge-base origin/"$BASE_BRANCH" HEAD)
          echo "MERGE_BASE=$MERGE_BASE" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          BASE_ONLY=$(git diff --name-only "$MERGE_BASE" origin/"$BASE_BRANCH")
          echo "$BASE_ONLY" > base-only.txt
          echo "## Base‑only files" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          cat base-only.txt >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

      - name: Rebase onto base branch
        run: |
          set -e
          git rebase --no-ff --no-commit origin/"$BASE_BRANCH"
          if git ls-files -u | grep -q .; then
            echo "⚠️ Conflicts remain after rebase. Please resolve them manually."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify base‑only files unchanged after rebase
        run: |
          set -e
          while read -r file; do
            if ! git diff --exit-code origin/"$BASE_BRANCH" -- "$file"; then
              echo "❌ File $file differs from base branch after rebase."
              exit 1
            fi
          done < base-only.txt

      - name: Check for unintended net deletions
        run: |
          set -e
          # Detect any file that has deletions but no insertions
          if git diff --numstat origin/"$BASE_BRANCH" HEAD | awk '$2>0 && $1==0 {print $0; exit 1}'; then
            echo "❌ Unintended net deletions detected in one or more files."
            exit 1
          fi
          # Optionally, also warn if total deletions exceed total insertions
          TOTAL_DELETIONS=$(git diff --numstat origin/"$BASE_BRANCH" HEAD | awk '{sum+=$2} END {print sum}')
          TOTAL_INSERTIONS=$(git diff --numstat origin/"$BASE_BRANCH" HEAD | awk '{sum+=$1} END {print sum}')
          if [ "$TOTAL_DELETIONS" -gt 0 ] && [ "$TOTAL_INSERTIONS" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "⚠️ Total deletions ($TOTAL_DELETIONS) exceed total insertions ($TOTAL_INSERTIONS)."
          fi
```
